mapper.insert: INSERT INTO projects (client_id, title, description, start_date, deadline_date, est_duration, duration_negotiable, budget, budget_negotiable, communicate_method, payment_method, max_revision_count, change_policy, project_status, is_public, plan_url, file_size) VALUES (#{clientId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{deadlineDate}, #{estDuration}, #{durationNegotiable}, #{budget}, #{budgetNegotiable}, #{communicateMethod}, #{paymentMethod}, #{maxRevisionCount}, #{changePolicy}, #{projectStatus}, #{isPublic}, #{planUrl}, #{fileSize})
INSERT INTO project_stacks (project_id, stack_id, stack_level, stack_year) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{stackId}, #{stackLevel}, #{stackYear})
mapper.select: SELECT s.stack_id, s.stack_name, s.category FROM project_stacks ps JOIN stacks s ON ps.stack_id = s.stack_id WHERE ps.project_id = #{projectId}
SELECT * FROM project_stacks WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND stack_level > 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE projects SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, budget = #{budget}, budget_negotiable = #{budgetNegotiable}, est_duration = #{estDuration}, duration_negotiable = #{durationNegotiable}, start_date = #{startDate}, deadline_date = #{deadlineDate}, communicate_method = #{communicateMethod}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, max_revision_count = #{maxRevisionCount}, change_policy = #{changePolicy}, updated_at = NOW() , plan_url = #{planUrl}, file_size = #{fileSize} WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
